harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: His saying «الذي»: naʿt (adjective) of «ربك»; the preposition «باسم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: read, beginning with the name.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «خلق» is a badal (substitute) of the preceding « {خَلَقَ} ».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «ربك الأكرم»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «الذي»: naʿt (adjective); the preposition «بالقلم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the bāʾ is that of seeking aid (istiʿāna).

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «علَّم» is a badal (substitute) of the preceding one.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: (أن رآه استغنى) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition, the lām; the clause «استغنى» is the second object of the mental seeing; and the verb of the attached latent pronoun was made transitive to its own attached pronoun, and He did not say: أن رأى نفسه (that he saw himself).

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: (إن إلى ربك الرجعى) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: His saying «الذي»: a relative noun, the first object of «أرأيت» in the sense of "tell me"; the second object is indicated by the interrogative clause in verse (14), which is the object of the third.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The first object of «رأيت» is a pronoun referring to {الَّذِي يَنْهَى}, which occurs as the object of the first «أرأيت»; the second object was omitted because the second object of the third «أرأيت» indicates it. Thus the second was omitted from the first, the first from the third, and both from the second; and that is of the kind of omission on account of indication. The clause «إن كان على الهدى» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the interrogative clause of the second object {أَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَرَى}.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: (ألم يعلم بأن الله يرى) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) for emphasis, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) stands in place of the two objects of علم.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The lām is the preparatory one (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa), and «نَسْفَعَنْ» is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the light nūn of emphasis; the nūn has no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: (فليدع ناديه) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.
